about_the_game:
One day, all of a sudden, you find yourself becoming a ghost.
You've never committed any evil. Your soul would surely be judged favorably.

It no longer mattered how great of a place it was.
The thought of being separated from him sounded more terrifying than purgatory.

You know what you need to do...

If you can't visit him anymore...
Then you have to bring him with you!
You're sure he would understand.
You need to bring him to your side before your spirit passes on.

You have to XXXX your beloved...

About the System

This is a point-and-click, command-selection style adventure game where the protagonist is a girl who has become a ghost.
The objective is to fulfill her desires by speaking to her beloved "him," causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing.
However, as a ghost, you cannot easily communicate with "him," who has no spiritual awareness. Through trial and error, try to bring about the desired outcome.
The main story has six different endings, with each playthrough taking about 15 minutes. The story changes based on your choices and actions.

Additional Features from the Classic Version


- Prologue Added: A prologue has been included that tells the story of your life before becoming a ghost.
- Menu Commands Added: Features like saving and an ending list have been added, making gameplay more user-friendly.
- Clear Bonuses Added: As a reward for clearing the game, an illustration gallery is now available. It also includes trivia and design materials.
- Sound Added: New music tracks and sound effects have been added by the artist of the main theme. Additionally, a soundtrack release is planned, so enjoy the wonderful music!

content_descriptors.notes: The protagonist's wish is to take her lover with her to the afterlife, so the text contains references to murder.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and up
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: This app features mouse, keyboard controls and partial controller support with the Xbox controller. Touch screen is not supported.
